item.title: Mississippi Museum of Natural Science hosting ‘Later Gator’ Valentine’s Day event

item.title: Wicker: ICE will ‘look elsewhere’ to open detention facility, moving on from Mississippi site
item.description: The federal government has reversed course and will not convert a north Mississippi warehouse into a holding center for undocumented immigrants. U.S. Sen. item.title: SEC distributing more than $1B to its schools for the 2024-25 fiscal year
item.description: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (AP) — The Southeastern Conference is distributing more than $1 billion to its 16 universities for the 2024-25 fiscal year, which ended last August. The total distribution jumped more than $200 million from the previous year. item.description: The death count linked to Winter Storm Fern has risen in Mississippi.
